Check and control: [ ] M — Route and current authority set are resolved.
Pass evidence and failure action: Record the degree route, programme, cohort or status, applicable regulations, current calendar, faculty instructions, forms and examination conditions. Any conflict needed for action blocks the tick. Sources E1–E8.

Check and control: [ ] M — Candidate identity, exact title and supervisor record agree.
Pass evidence and failure action: Compare the official system, topic approval, registration form, title page, final PDF and departmental record. Resolve legal-name, spelling, diacritic or title differences before transmission. Sources E1, E2, E5, E6 and, when the mobility-only route is triggered, E9–E10.

Check and control: [ ] M — One final scientific state has been frozen and validated.
Pass evidence and failure action: The question, data or corpus, method, code, results, principal claim, limitations, figures and tables agree across the similarity-reviewed file, supervisor-approved file, examination copy and slides. Scientific drift returns to the earliest responsible gate. Sources E1 and E2.

Check and control: [ ] M — Mandatory declarations accurately describe the frozen work.
Pass evidence and failure action: Use the current originality, data-protection, generative-AI and other required forms. Verify placement, signature, date, title and declared use or non-use. An absent or inaccurate mandatory declaration blocks submission. Sources E1–E3, E5 and E6.

Check and control: [ ] C — Every route- or status-triggered document has been activated.
Pass evidence and failure action: Check previous cohort, additional year, mobility, external university, fee, identity change, account access and other conditions. Record the trigger and current evidence. Conditional becomes mandatory when activated. Sources E1, E2, E5, E6 and, when the mobility-only route is triggered, E9–E10.

Check and control: [ ] R — The authoritative release is uniquely identifiable.
Pass evidence and failure action: Record filename, version, date, SHA-256 hash, manifest and storage location for the final PDF and consequential artefacts. Remove or quarantine ambiguous near-final copies.

Check and control: [ ] R — Private, administrative, examination and public packages are separated.
Pass evidence and failure action: Keep identity documents, signatures, receipts, confidential data, scientific evidence and release candidates in their correct access classes. Do not place the administrative dossier in GitHub, Zenodo or a public companion.

Check and control: [ ] R — An authorised second person has completed an identity and openability test.
Pass evidence and failure action: The reviewer identifies the authoritative state, opens the actual final files, compares sampled claims, checks declarations and records defects without oral repair from the student.
